# Workplace IT

> Workplace IT (WIT) is a Denver, Colorado managed IT and cybersecurity provider for businesses with 20-200 employees, and a Cyber AB Registered Practitioner Organization (RPO) that helps defense contractors prepare for CMMC Level 1 and Level 2. Business clients only; no residential work.

- Address: 1514 Curtis St., Suite 200, Denver, CO 80202
- Phone: (720) 647-9900
- Email: info@workplaceit.net
- Service area: Denver Metro area and Colorado
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm Mountain Time; 24/7 monitoring
- Support: under 1-hour average response time, local Denver engineers, flat-rate monthly pricing

## Services

- [Managed IT Support](https://workplaceit.net/services/managed-it-support.html): 24/7 monitoring, helpdesk, patching, vCIO for Denver businesses
- [Cybersecurity](https://workplaceit.net/services/cybersecurity.html): endpoint protection, security operations, email security
- [CMMC Compliance in Denver](https://workplaceit.net/cmmc-compliance-denver.html): CMMC Level 1 and 2 gap assessments, remediation, C3PAO preparation
- [CMMC Compliance across Colorado](https://workplaceit.net/cmmc-compliance-colorado.html): statewide CMMC services for defense contractors
- [Microsoft 365 GCC High Migration](https://workplaceit.net/services/gcc-high-migration.html): GCC High tenant builds and commercial-to-GCC High migrations
- [IT Compliance](https://workplaceit.net/services/it-compliance.html): SSP, POA&M and policy documentation for NIST SP 800-171 and other frameworks
- [Data Cabling Denver](https://workplaceit.net/data-cabling-denver.html): Cat6, fiber and low-voltage installation for businesses
- [Security Cameras Denver](https://workplaceit.net/security-cameras-denver.html): business video surveillance
- [Backup & Recovery](https://workplaceit.net/services/backup-recovery.html), [VoIP](https://workplaceit.net/services/voip.html), [Cloud Management](https://workplaceit.net/services/cloud-management.html), [AI Business Automation](https://workplaceit.net/services/ai-business-automation.html)
